purpose: Prepare an evidence-based request to review a MetaMask/Blockaid security classification; this is not a claim that the alert is a false positive.

proposedExternalRequest.subject: Please review the security classification for kleros-luma-ethereum.netlify.app on Ethereum
proposedExternalRequest.body: MetaMask displayed a Blockaid-powered malicious warning when this portal requested an Ethereum event-creation transaction. The screenshot shows Added protection enabled. Transaction 0xef60cbf9c65883eb3a1daf6f250bd6cc8328ba655270e897ba17870b1d8a06dc succeeded through 0xdb9B1e94B5b69Df7e401DDbedE43491141047dB3 and emitted EventCreated from factory 0xEe049D03a007e150ec8ec46B066823043BAcf14E. The portal's direct-transaction compatibility check rejected that envelope; we are investigating this separately. Please identify the specific flagged entity and reason and review the classification. We are not asserting that the warning is a false positive. No credentials, signing material or private event terms are included.
